body:
# UA & Paid Media Strategy: Summer 2026 (World Cup + NBA Finals)
**Underdog Sports | Prepared by: UA Manager | Date: April 13, 2026**

---

## Strategic Context

Underdog Sports enters Summer 2026 with two overlapping acquisition windows: **NBA Finals (~June 4–21)** and **World Cup 2026 (June 11–July 19, US-hosted)**. This is a once-in-a-generation World Cup moment — first US-hosted since 1994, expanded to 48 teams, held in Underdog's home market. DraftKings and FanDuel are sportsbook-first; their soccer fantasy products are thin. **This is a blue ocean, not a war of attrition.**

Core differentiators to amplify: friendlier UX, better payouts, fantasy-native (not sportsbook-adjacent), Best Ball format for soccer.

---

## 1. Channel Strategy & Budget Allocation

### Framework: Event-Phased Budget

| Phase | Dates | Budget Weight | Focus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pre-warm | May 1–June 10 | 15% | Creator seeding, email capture, retargeting list build |
| NBA Finals | June 4–21 | 25% | Cross-sport prospecting, retargeting existing |
| World Cup Group Stage | June 11–30 | 35% | Mass soccer audience acquisition |
| World Cup Knockout | July 1–19 | 25% | Efficiency push, retargeting, final conversion |

### Channel Mix & Allocation

| Channel | % of Budget | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Meta (prospecting + retargeting) | 35% | Volume engine, retargeting converter |
| Creator/Influencer | 25% | Trust, soccer-native credibility, best performing format |
| Google UAC | 15% | Intent capture (branded + sports fantasy queries) |
| Podcasts/Audio | 15% | Reach extension, soccer + NBA podcast adjacent audience |
| CTV/Streaming | 10% | Brand awareness, reach during live game viewing |

**Rationale:** Creator/influencer weighted higher than typical UA mix because (a) this category converts on credibility not interruption, and (b) the soccer creator ecosystem is under-monetized vs. NFL/NBA — CPM rates and exclusivity are more favorable.

---

## 2. World Cup Campaign Plan

### Target Audiences

**Tier 1 — Soccer fans, fantasy-curious (largest opportunity)**
- US-based soccer fans 18–44, heavy MLS/Liga MX/EPL interest
- Behavioral: FIFA/soccer game players, sports media apps, fantasy sports adjacent
- Platform signals: Meta soccer interest layers, YouTube soccer channel viewers via Google UAC

**Tier 2 — Existing DFS/fantasy players (highest intent)**
- Lapsed DK/FD users (retargeting via email/CRM where available)
- Sports betting-adjacent (sports betting intent keywords, retarget site visitors)

**Tier 3 — Underdog existing users (LTV extension)**
- Current users without soccer picks history → push reactivation via owned channels (push, email), not paid media

### Creative Angles (Hook → Value → Proof → CTA)

**Angle 1 — "Soccer finally has a fantasy league you'll actually win"**
- Hook: "DraftKings doesn't have a real soccer fantasy game. We do."
- Value: Best Ball format — set roster once, no daily management
- Proof: Payout testimonials from soccer-specific players
- CTA: "Pick your World Cup squad free →"

**Angle 2 — "Every American is a soccer analyst this summer"**
- Hook: Creator talking head picking World Cup Best Ball roster on camera
- Value: Picks take 5 minutes, no daily lineup changes
- Proof: Creator's past winnings or leaderboard clip
- CTA: "Join [Creator Name]'s league →"

**Angle 3 — "The World Cup only happens every 4 years"**
- Hook: FOMO/urgency around US-hosted tournament
- Value: Larger prize pools tied to World Cup engagement spike
- Proof: Social proof — "X players already joined the World Cup pool"
- CTA: "Lock in your picks before June 11 →"

**Variant set (5 hooks for testing):**
- A: Comparison (vs. sportsbooks — no bets required)
- B: Creator UGC-style (lo-fi, authentic, talking head)
- C: Hype/event reel (World Cup stadium, crowd, USMNT)
- D: Payout/winning focus ("I won $2,400 on Best Ball last year")
- E: Education ("Best Ball explained in 60 seconds")

### Timing

- **May 1–June 10 (pre-warm):** Creator seeding only. Micro-influencer drops with referral codes. No heavy paid spend — build lists and track organic CVR baseline.
- **June 4 (NBA Finals Game 1):** Activate Meta + UAC. Cross-sport audiences. Light CTV + podcast.
- **June 11 (World Cup Group Stage):** Full activation. Creator content drops same day. Surge paid social.
- **June 30 (Round of 16 / knockout draw):** Refresh creative. New creator content on surviving picks and tournament narrative.
- **July 1–19 (knockouts):** Efficiency mode. Shift prospecting/retargeting ratio to 40/60. Reduce net-new prospecting; maximize conversion of warm audiences.

### Offer / Incentive Structure

| Offer | Target | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| First entry free (Best Ball World Cup slate) | New users | Lowest friction — no deposit required |
| Deposit match (100% up to $50) | High-intent prospects | For channels where CPA > $100 |
| Referral bonus ($25 credit, both sides) | Existing users | Drive K-factor via friend sharing |
| Creator promo code (bonus entries) | Creator audiences | Trackable per creator via unique codes |

**Recommendation:** Lead with free entry for World Cup. Lower barrier = higher volume = better retention data. Deposit match as second-touch offer in retargeting.

---

## 3. NBA Finals Campaign Plan

### Context
NBA Finals overlaps World Cup Group Stage start. 25% of Summer budget. Converts a known, high-intent audience. Owned channels carry most of the existing user reactivation load.

### Audiences
- NBA fantasy players (existing and lapsed DFS)
- Underdog existing NBA users → owned channels (push/email), not paid

### Creative Angles

**Angle 1 — "Best Ball doesn't end when the season does"**
- Hook: "Your team got knocked out. Your fantasy picks? Still alive."
- Value: Best Ball format survives upsets
- CTA: "Build your Finals lineup →"

**Angle 2 — "Pick the winner. Cash out."**
- Hook: Prop-picks format — single prediction, simple and low-friction
- Value: No complex roster management; one pick wins
- CTA: "Make your Finals pick →"

### Channel Mix (NBA Finals)
- Meta (50%): Retarget lapsed NBA users, prospect NBA fans
- Google UAC (30%): NBA Finals search spike intent
- Creator (20%): Basketball-native creator activations

### Timing
- Pre-Finals (June 1–3): Teaser creative, email to existing users
- Games 1–2 (June 4–8): Full spend. Max bid in game-adjacent windows (pre-game, halftime, post-game)
- Games 3–7 (June 9–21): Ride performance. Cut losing ad sets weekly. No new creative mid-flight unless top ad set CTR drops >25%.

---

## 4. Welcome Offer & Referral Incentive Testing Plan

### Hypotheses

| # | Hypothesis | Test Design | Decision Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Free entry drives higher volume but lower D30 retention vs. deposit match | 50/50 geo split; measure FTD rate + D30 active rate | Ship free entry if D30 retention ≥15% AND volume >1.5x deposit match cohort |
| H2 | Two-sided referral ($25/$25) outperforms one-sided ($50 referrer) on K-factor | A/B in-app: 50/50 user split; measure referral sends + referred-user FTD CVR | Ship two-sided if K-factor lift >20% at 90% significance |
| H3 | Creator promo codes convert at higher rate than generic paid social CTA | Creator landing page (with code) vs. generic paid; measure CVR install-to-FTD | Ship creator approach if CVR delta >15% |
| H4 | Deposit match cap ($50 vs $100) does not materially affect FTD CVR | 50/50 new user split; measure FTD CVR + D30 LTV proxy | Ship $50 cap if CVR delta <5%; $100 cap only if D30 LTV >1.4x |

**Test standards:**
- Minimum 500 conversions per cell before reading
- Primary metric: FTD rate
- Guardrail metric: D7 retention (no optimizing for one-time depositors)
- Minimum duration: 2 weeks; early stop only at >95% significance + no guardrail violation

---

## 5. CPA Targets by Channel

**Benchmark basis:** DraftKings blended CAC ~$400–500 per depositing user at peak (public filings). FanDuel similar range. Underdog operates in fantasy-specific space with lower competitive intensity — apply 35–50% discount for equivalent quality users.

| Channel | Target CPA (FTD) | Scale Threshold | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Creator/Influencer | $65–110 | >$143 → pause | Lowest friction; tracked via promo codes |
| Podcasts/Audio | $80–130 | >$169 → pause | Use unique URLs/codes for attribution |
| Meta (retargeting) | $40–70 | >$91 → pause | Warm audience; expect 2–3x better CVR |
| Meta (prospecting) | $120–180 | >$234 → pause | Volume channel; optimize to FTD not install |
| Google UAC | $150–220 | >$286 → pause | World Cup keyword costs will spike; monitor daily |
| CTV/Streaming | $200–350 | Awareness only | Measured via brand search lift + geo holdout |

**Scaling rule:** Increase spend past 1.3x target CPA only if D30 retention is above LTV guardrail. If CPA exceeds 1.5x target, pause that ad set (not the whole channel) and investigate creative/audience issue first.

---

## 6. LTV Guardrails

### Minimum D30 Retention Before Scaling Spend

| Cohort | D7 Floor | D30 Floor | Action if Below |
|---|---|---|---|
| All new FTD (any channel) | 35% | 18% | Pause scaling; investigate channel mix and creative |
| Creator-sourced | 40% | 22% | Higher bar — creator audiences expected to be higher quality |
| Organic/referral (baseline) | 50% | 28% | Benchmark for all cohort comparisons |

**If D30 retention drops below 15% on any single channel cohort during campaign:** Pause that channel, do not reduce other channels. Investigate whether offer structure or audience targeting is driving low-quality users.

### LTV Proxy Metric
- No 12-month LTV data available in-campaign; use **D30 active days** (days with ≥1 pick or deposit action)
- Target: ≥5 active days in first 30 days = "retained"
- Flag cohorts below this threshold in weekly reporting and in channel-level CPA reconciliation

---

## 7. Measurement Plan

### Primary KPIs

| KPI | Target | Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| FTD by channel | Channel targets (§5) | Daily during campaign |
| CPA by channel | At or below target | Daily |
| D7 Retention | ≥35% blended | Weekly |
| D30 Retention | ≥18% blended | Monthly |
| K-Factor (referral) | >0.2 target, >0.5 stretch | Weekly |
| Install-to-FTD CVR | ≥18% | Weekly |
| Branded search volume | +20% WoW during WC Group Stage | Weekly |

### Attribution Approach

**Primary:** Mobile MMP (AppsFlyer) for install + event attribution
- FTD = primary conversion event
- D7 and D30 re-engagement events = secondary events
- View-through window: 1 day (Meta only); off for Google UAC (VTA inflation risk)
- Click lookback: 7-day for all channels

**Platform-reported (Meta, Google Ads):** Use for bid optimization signal only. Expect 15–25% over-reporting vs. MMP — do not use for stakeholder reporting or budget decisions.

**Creator/Podcast:** Promo code as primary. Supplement with UTM-tagged landing pages. Last-touch to promo code for attribution.

### Incrementality Test: Meta Prospecting (World Cup Group Stage)

**Design:** Geo-based holdout
- 80% of target DMAs → full Meta spend (treatment)
- 20% of matched DMAs → $0 Meta spend (control)
- Match on: DMA size, historical FTD rate, soccer interest index

**Timeline:** June 11–30 (full Group Stage = 3 weeks, enough signal)

**Metrics:**
- Primary: FTD rate, treatment vs. control (incremental lift)
- Secondary: Branded search volume lift in treatment vs. control

**Decision rule:**
- Incremental lift >0 at 80% confidence → Meta is driving real volume; maintain spend
- Lift not distinguishable from 0 → evaluate reallocating to creator or podcasts where attribution is more direct

---

## Open Items / Dependencies

1. **Budget:** Dollar amounts TBD — framework is allocation-relative. CMO to confirm total Summer 2026 UA budget for absolute CPA calibration.
2. **Creator roster:** 8–12 soccer-native creators needed by May 1 for content production lead time. Recommend micro-tier (100K–500K followers) — lower CPM, higher engagement in soccer niche.
3. **Legal/compliance:** Deposit-match offers require state-by-state legal review. Flag to legal by May 1.
4. **MMP config:** AppsFlyer FTD + D7/D30 re-engagement event taxonomy must be live and QA'd before June 1.
5. **Landing pages:** Soccer/World Cup-specific landing page needed (distinct from default homepage). Creative team priority.

---
